title: Fairphone 6 wide camera experimental Linux support
summary: This article documents experimental work to enable wide-angle camera support on the Fairphone 6 when running Linux-based operating systems. The author reverse-engineered and developed driver support for camera hardware that wasn't originally supported in the Linux kernel, providing practical functionality for mobile Linux users.
problem_solved: Enables the wide-angle camera on Fairphone 6 to work under Linux-based operating systems where it was previously non-functional.
why_valuable: Advances mobile Linux ecosystem by expanding hardware support, giving users more functional cameras on open-source hardware platforms like Fairphone.
